subject: Sprint 21: Observability small-batch deliverables + eviction policy review
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@cloudscale.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint 21: Observability small-batch deliverables + eviction policy review

Quick context: CloudScale's pilot next month is a good forcing function to land a small set of console improvements that give them per-tenant cost/latency slices and clearer guidance when KV/cache evictions occur. Rebecca is looping security in but asked for a concrete list and timeline.

Ask (Sprint 21 goal: 2-week work):
- Deliver a per-tenant "slice" card in the Console that shows 95th/median latency, token cost, and % of requests hitting eviction windows (sampling-enabled).
- Add a lightweight heatmap drill for the top 5 routes for a tenant (configurable time window).
- Surface an "Eviction events" timeline with sample traces and the last-configured quantization/profile used.

Constraints / non-goals:
- Not building full per-request replay; sampling + 10-sample traces is OK for MVP.
- No billing changes; just attribution UI and links to existing billing records.

Owner proposals: Marissa -> UI/UX for card + heatmap; Irene -> telemetry schema + sampling; Dylan -> backend fetch/aggregation + light index; Soojin -> rollout + docs + canary gating.

Rebecca, can you confirm whether CloudScale needs SOC2-level evidence for the sampling mechanism or if a design doc + audit log is sufficient for now? We should also pick a hard date for a partner demo.

Attachments: observability_mvp_sketch.png (mockup), eviction_policy_draft.md (initial notes on eviction detection).

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Head of Product (Observability)
Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@cloudscale.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Oct 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint 21: Observability small-batch deliverables + eviction policy review

Thanks — this is clear and reasonable. Quick clarifying notes from a UI perspective:
- The per-tenant slice card should be composable to sit on the tenant detail page and also in a shared "tenant watchlist" tile.
- For the heatmap, I recommend: bins by hour (24h default), route rows limited to top-5 by token spend, color scale anchored at baseline percentiles (p50/p95).
- Eviction events timeline: show event markers with hover showing a 1-line summary and link to the sampled trace (no inline trace rendering in MVP).

I'll attach a very small mock (observability_mvp_sketch.png) with two layout options. If folks agree I'll scope the UI tasks into two PRs (card + heatmap) so we can ship independently.

One question for Irene/Dylan: sampling rate and the storage cost estimate for keeping 10 samples per eviction event across our retention window — can you give a rough number by EOD Monday?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Designer, Console
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rebecca Lin <rebecca@cloudscale.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, CloudScale Security <security@cloudscale.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Oct 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint 21: Observability small-batch deliverables + eviction policy review

Appreciate the quick alignment. From a partner perspective:
- The demo is for our platform and two internal teams; target date is Nov 7th (ideally a 30min walk-through + Q&A).
- For compliance: security would like to see an audit log + design doc for sampling+storage (we don't need a full SOC box for the pilot). I'll have our security PM (cc'd) review the eviction_policy_draft.md and flag any must-haves.
- Two asks for the UI: include an "export sample" button that gives a redacted trace (remove any PII) and a one-click link to the HubSpot incident if we want to open a support ticket.

If you can confirm timeline and whether the export redaction is feasible for MVP that helps our internal scheduling.

—Rebecca
Rebecca Lin
Director of Platform Partnerships
CloudScale Inc.
rebecca@cloudscale.com

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@cloudscale.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Oct 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint 21: Observability small-batch deliverables + eviction policy review

Team — good feedback. Quick commitments and risks: 
- Demo: Nov 7th confirmed (I'll block 30m + prep slot).
- Export redaction: modeled after existing trace-redaction job. Irene, can you confirm we can expose a redacted export endpoint (configurable per-tenant) by Nov 1? If not, we will ship the UI and show a placeholder export with a note.
- Storage estimate: Dylan, please prioritize a ballpark by tomorrow EOD; if it's >15% of our current telemetry storage we may need to reduce sample retention or increase sampling thresholds.

Rollout plan: Canary to 5% of tenants first (internal + CloudScale), monitor error rates and storage, then 25% -> 100% over two weeks if no regressions. Soojin, I'll need a 1-page playbook for the canary (who to page, rollback criteria, runbook links).

I'll upload a cleaned eviction_policy_draft.md to the Confluence page and link it in the ticket.

Thanks — Avery

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@cloudscale.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Oct 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint 21: Observability small-batch deliverables + eviction policy review

Acknowledged — I'll draft the canary playbook today and include:
- Canary criteria (latency P95 delta >10% or >5% error uplift triggers rollback),
- Storage gate (if sample store growth >12% vs baseline, stop roll),
- Notification list (eng-oncall, infra leader, product owner),
- Quick rollback steps (disable sampling via feature flag, block exports).

I'll post the playbook to OBS-421 and ping the oncall rotation. Also adding a short note on how eviction markers are computed (threshold-based + telemetry-derived spikes) so CloudScale's security can validate.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
SRE / Observability
soojin_lee@redwood.com
